'''Hardy Storage Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001111711/000095013708003307/c23373e10vk.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000078460/000095012307017176/g11035e10vk.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Hardy Storage field, West Virginia to Columbia Gas Transmission system, Hampshire County, West Virginia.

==Project Details==
===Main Line===
*'''Owner: '''Hardy Storage Co LLC<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2005/08/12/E5-4364/columbia-gas-transmission-corporation-hardy-storage-company-llc-notice-of-availability-of-the|title=federalregister.gov|website=federalregister.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''36.8 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2005/08/12/E5-4364/columbia-gas-transmission-corporation-hardy-storage-company-llc-notice-of-availability-of-the|title=federalregister.gov|website=federalregister.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001111711/000095013708003307/c23373e10vk.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000078460/000095012307017176/g11035e10vk.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Start year: '''2007<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001111711/000095013708003307/c23373e10vk.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000078460/000095012307017176/g11035e10vk.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
